definitions.logical_item: One requested (source episode, selected recorded request) replay; repeats are charged again.
definitions.source_episode: Unique recorded episode identifier; different policy rollouts at one nominal slot are distinct episodes.
definitions.validated_capture: Every requested item checked and passed the 0.02 gate, with a successful command.
definitions.failed_parity_capture: At least one requested replay failed or was invalid; passing items inside it do not validate the whole capture.
definitions.unchecked_diagnostic: Successful capture whose replay comparisons were all explicitly skipped; not a validated base capture.
definitions.wall_time: Observed editor-driver duration including reasoning, tool work, simulator evaluations and waiting; not isolated inference compute time.
